notes: #5, #6, #3 and #2 are the same vol. 6 plate (inscribed 1617); #5 is the largest clean colored copy. #8’s museum date is 1685–1700; its caption records the imperial capture of 1685. #9 (Koppmayer) is dated only ‘17th century’. #11 (1786) is a council list with a small, blurry skyline photographed through glass — skipped. For P4, #13 is a general photochrom view from the vineyards, but the cathedral is tiny in it; #12 and #15 are the same cathedral photochrom. #17 artist field reads only ‘Of’; the left part of the panorama is a modern office block, so center the crop on the old town.
